stem:
The diagram shows a $2$ by $1$ by $1$ solid of unit cubes on an isometric grid. Komal wants to read its length, depth, and height from the grid.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Count $2$ units along length, $1$ along depth, and $1$ along height using the three isometric grid directions.
Count the solid on a square grid only; the three isometric directions are not needed.
The three isometric grid directions are produced by the $2$ by $1$ by $1$ solid.
The same three isometric directions also serve for every flat square-grid drawing of a rectangle.

tikz: \begin{tikzpicture}[line join=round,scale=0.95]\coordinate (O) at (0,0);\coordinate (A) at (2.4,0);\coordinate (B) at (1.8,0.42);\coordinate (C) at (-0.6,0.42);\coordinate (Ot) at (0,1.1);\coordinate (At) at (2.4,1.1);\coordinate (Bt) at (1.8,1.52);\coordinate (Ct) at (-0.6,1.52);\draw[gray!55,line width=0.35pt] (-1.2,-0.2)--(3.0,-0.2);\draw[gray!55,line width=0.35pt] (-1.5,0.2)--(2.7,0.2);\draw[gray!55,line width=0.35pt] (-1.8,0.6)--(2.4,0.6);\draw[gray!55,line width=0.35pt] (0,-0.3)--(0,2.0);\draw[gray!55,line width=0.35pt] (1.2,-0.3)--(1.2,2.0);\draw[gray!55,line width=0.35pt] (2.4,-0.3)--(2.4,2.0);\draw[thick,fill=gray!12] (O)--(A)--(At)--(Ot)--cycle;\draw[thick,fill=gray!22] (A)--(B)--(Bt)--(At)--cycle;\draw[thick,fill=gray!32] (Ot)--(At)--(Bt)--(Ct)--cycle;\draw[thick] (1.2,0)--(1.2,1.1);\end{tikzpicture}

teacher.key_rationale: On an isometric grid, length, depth, and height align with the three grid directions; count 2, 1, and 1 along those axes. Dropping the isometric directions, reversing solid and grid, or applying isometric axes to ordinary square-grid flats all miss the hinge.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote the square-grid kite into a 2×1×1 rectangular solid on an isometric-style grid.
